source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: showTab accepts the documented values app, addressBook, calendar, export and start. It stores the semantic value in currentTab and location.hash, then derives tabPane-${paneId} for DOM lookup. Markup retains existing mixed-case DOM IDs such as tabPane-addressBook. The export test opens about:import#export, so it tests startup dispatch instead of calling showTab after loading. An app hash cannot restore profile selection and resets to start. Manual naming proposal for this import flow: keep data and URL state free of DOM-only prefixes; add the DOM prefix at the rendering boundary and document the finite values. This does not establish a repository-wide dash-versus-camel rule or authorize renaming legacy IDs.
title: Import state uses semantic pane IDs and adds the DOM prefix at lookup
